title: Bound Engram check snapshots when the enclosing worktree is far above the workdir (home dotfiles repo)
outcome: From tm-winf round-7 review (Claude, Low). engram_worktree_root_path uses the nearest ancestor holding .git, so a session in a non-repo folder under a dotfiles repository at the home directory (non-bare ~/.git) snapshots the whole home worktree: every mediated turn close and every recognised check start and end runs a review-freeze of it, bounded only by REVIEW_FREEZE_TIMEOUT (20 s) and the freeze input budgets. Each check start/end also spawns a detached capture thread (EngramCapture::spawn) with no cap on concurrent captures when an agent runs tests in a loop. Options: cap concurrent captures per session; skip or refuse the basis when the root is an ancestor far above the workdir or is the home directory; at minimum keep the documented caveat (docs/features/engram-host-adapter.md, Freshness). Accept: a session under a home-level repository does not freeze the whole home on each check, and concurrent captures are bounded.
